items.title: NetApp (NTAP) Reports Q2 Earnings on December 1 — Here’s What Analysts Expect
items.summary: U.S. enterprise storage vendor NetApp (NTAP) is preparing to release its fiscal Q2 2027 earnings next Tuesday, December 1, after the market closes. NTAP stock is up about 54% since the start of the year. Still, analysts are split over whether the company can sustain its growth. For reference, Wall Street expects NetApp to report revenue of $2.11 billion, up by 24% from $1.70 billion last year.
